operation.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Creates multiple refund receipts in a single request. The request body is a **JSON array**; each element has the same shape as the body of **Add New Refund Receipt** (an object with an `Invoice` member — `RefundReceipt` is also accepted — plus optional `InvoiceItem`, `Payment`, etc.).

Each element must set `Invoice.subscription_id` to the **source invoice being refunded** (despite the name, this is not a subscription). That source invoice must be an issued (non-draft) standard invoice.

Refund receipts are created **one by one and the operation is not atomic** — if one element fails the others are still created. The response is a **JSON array** with one result object per submitted element, in request order:

| Outcome | Item fields |
|---|---|
| Success | `result` = `successful`, `code` = `202`, `id`, `invoice_number` |
| Failure | `message`, `validation_errors` (and sometimes `error_type` / `extra_data`) |

The overall response is `200` regardless of individual outcomes, so you must inspect each element. Per-element field and defaulting behaviour is identical to **Add New Refund Receipt** — see that endpoint for the full field reference.

schema.description: Array of refund receipts to create. Each element has the same shape as the body of Add New Refund Receipt (an object with an `Invoice` member plus optional `InvoiceItem`, `Payment`, etc.).

Invoice.description: Refund receipt header. The `RefundReceipt` key is also accepted and treated as `Invoice`.

subscription_id.description: **Required.** The ID of the source invoice being refunded (despite the field name, this is not a subscription). The source invoice must be an issued (non-draft) standard invoice. An element with no `subscription_id` fails with `Invoice not found`.

date.description: Refund receipt date (YYYY-MM-DD). Must fall within an open financial period.

currency_code.description: Currency code (for example, `USD`). Optional — defaults to the account currency.

InvoiceItem.description: Line items being refunded. Same shape as Add New Refund Receipt / Add New Invoice line items.

200.description: All elements processed. Each array element is either a success object (`result`/`code`/`id`/`invoice_number`) or an error object (`message`/`validation_errors`).

schema.description: One result object per submitted element, in request order. A 200 does not guarantee every refund receipt was created — inspect each element. Successful items carry the created refund receipt id/number; failed items carry an error result.

id.description: The new refund receipt id (successful items).

invoice_number.description: The generated refund receipt number (successful items).

validation_errors.description: Field-level or general error messages (failed items).

extra_data.description: Additional error context, when set (failed items).

403.description: You do not have permission to create refund receipts. Note: a permission failure (or a draft source invoice) on any single element can abort the whole batch with this status rather than failing only that element.
